name: Zajchik: Rebuild
source:
When winter comes, everything falls into slumber - everything except this forest.

There's something wandering its snow-covered paths, lurking behind black trees, and taking whatever it considers due.

It leaves behind strange rumors: voices calling you into the thicket, faces watching through your windows, mysterious prints in the snow, and… a growing number of missing-child posters.

Those who have heard the voice of the forest are beyond help. Their only option is to sink deeper and deeper into its cold embrace and face their final choice in that icy darkness: to stay alive… or to stay human?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249880/]Steam[/url]]

This version promises to refine lore with a greater emphasis on mysticism and shamanism, make the story coherent and consistent, correct all the plot and graphical errors, and remove the need to play every route to understand the entire story.
translation:
当冬天来临时，一切都陷入沉睡——除了这片森林。

有某种东西在冰雪覆盖的小路上徘徊，潜伏在黑色的树后，并拿走它认为应得的一切。

它留下了奇怪的谣言：呼唤你进入灌木丛的声音、透过窗户观察的面孔、雪地里的神秘脚印，以及……越来越多的失踪儿童海报。

那些听到森林之声的人都无能为力。他们唯一的选择就是越来越深地陷入冰冷的怀抱中，并在冰冷的黑暗中面临最终的选择：活下去……还是继续做人？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249880/]Steam[/url]]

这个版本承诺完善传说，更加强调神秘主义和萨满教，使故事连贯一致，纠正所有情节和图形错误，并消除需要玩每条路线来理解整个故事的需要。
